strings.sms.heading: Aanyunet naka SMS
strings.sms.note: Epone loedolunia ainapeta ngun toma esimu loedit. Kotoma iboro kere luitemokinitai, itunganan yen ecamakitai aijukar akiro nuka SMS ngesi ijukari; mam aanyunet na ejukari idiobore.

strings.evidence.heading: Ibore yen esesenete isatelitei kotoma amisiri
strings.evidence.veg.heading: Aiboisit na iriokok kotoma okaru (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI erai enaaba lo itodunit epone lo eseseniata alupok kotoma aiboisit naka akwap. Arai edolit 0.1 apolouke ebe emamei iboro. 0.6 arai luipu itodunit iraan luepolok noi. Itodunit ngin ne ejai alupok nuejaasi keda iraan ka ne emamei.
strings.evidence.veg.low: Ipu noi ilapio lu emamei iraan (elwana akwap): {months}.
strings.evidence.veg.season: Etapit {season} ({months}): apolou naka NDVI {mean}, kotoma okaru loemamei edou {p20}, kotoma okaru loepol edou {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: Ikapun luiriokok noi eraasi luka apakio nuka aijar wok ido erai alupok luiriokok noi kolap Losodit kitoni Olap Loiwuniet, eringa egeuna aira. Konye mam epone ngol ejulakin kotoma apakio ngun aarei, aso mam ariokok bon epedori atiakakin kes.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: Mam ilapio luiriokok luka iraan eputosi keda apakio nuka aiboisit wok. Koanyanaar idirisan keda akorion lo atutubet arai bo kalenda loka iraan.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Aiboisit kangin naka aputo naka esatelite erai nepetai 6 ha. Erai efamu lo 2 ha. Aso imoriarit aputo ngin alupok nuejaasi eidunya keda efamu. Ikito arai ekajo loeyapiete keda amisiri epedorete aingop apakio nuemamei iboro. Apotu idouon kojalakisi aiboisio nuegelegela. Ejenete akoriok bon nu epoloete kotoma amisiri.
strings.evidence.veg.source: Aiboisit: NASA MODIS, 250 m, kangin apaarasia 16, {start} kitoni {end}.
strings.evidence.terrain.heading: Abeit naka alupok
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: Emamei ationis kane: akwap naelilim noi kotoma ikar 25 ajai kuju naka 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: Ejaasi amapu naka aiboisit keda 30 m squares. Ejaasi efamu lo loka 2 ha keda ikidioko bon luka squares. Itodunit epone loka alupok, mere aiboisio nuikidioko arai bo imoru kotoma amisiri kon.
strings.evidence.footprint: Iwomit sio ebe erai efamu lo 140 m square ido ejai kiding naka efamu.
strings.evidence.pos.high: Aiboisit naikiara: elosete akipi nuka edou kama ejai efamu
strings.evidence.pos.low: alupok nu edisiak: akipi nuka edou kotoma alupok nuikiara epedorete atukonokin ne
strings.evidence.pos.mid: Kiding naka aiboisit naepol: mam ejokuna noi arai epol arai edit
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Aitirianeta nuka edou auni
strings.evidence.rain.note: Iwaitin iuni luegelegela luka aipim edou ko amisiri. NASA POWER keda ERA5 eraasi aiwadikaeta nuka ekuse ka etepe, ido ecamanara kesi noi. GPM IMERG ipimio kotoma osatelliten kosodi aitodun edou loepol. Mam oni ijeni yen ejokuna kanu amisiri na. Arai erai egauge loka edou (ekopo loedumuni edou) itodunit ngun. Kanuka ngun itodunit app ngin iwaitin kere iuni.
strings.evidence.rain.col.et0: Akipi nu akolong ka ekwam epedorete aokot (ET0)
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 ngesi akipi nuipu noi nu epedori akolong keda ekwam aikamun kotoma apak adiope anyoun kotoma alupok nuejaasi keda akipi nu ekotosi. Itwasamai iraan atutubet naka akipi nu. Arai erai ET0 loepol adepar edou, itwasamaete iraan akipi nu ibwaikitai toma alupok.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Ipuak: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, kowai lo Open-Meteo; ET0 abu Open-Meteo kiswama).
strings.evidence.field.heading: Kotoma aiboisit naka efamu bon (30 m)
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: Etapit duc ebe erai efamu loemamei iboro, kotoma elap
strings.evidence.field.bare_what: Atutubet naka aputosia nu elomunitos kotoma akwap na esesenere kwape emamei iboro (NDVI lo edisiak adepar 0.25).
strings.evidence.field.least: Ilapio luikidioko akwii kotoma ocaalo loka amisiri: {months}.
strings.evidence.field.thin: Aputosia nuikidioko (nuikidioko adepar 8) kotoma: {months}. Itwasam ilapio ngun keda acoit.
strings.evidence.field.season: Etapit {season}: aiboisit naejok naka NDVI {mean}; emamei kotoma {bare} % loka aputosia nuajokak.
strings.evidence.field.source: Aiboisit: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 keda 9, 30 m, {clear} aputosia nu elai, {start} kitoni {end}.
strings.evidence.field.limit: Erai 140 m square aomisioit wok, mere aiboisit naepimatai. Apotu idowon koinakisi aputosia nuipu kotoma ilapio lu etepia edou. Mam NDVI epedori alimun inyamat bo ani eutai apolo arai bo kanukinyo emamei alupok.
